title: Student Burnout & Academic Strain Screening
purpose: Collects self-reported student well-being markers covering emotional exhaustion, academic detachment, and perceived study efficacy.
description: A structured 8-question self-report screening instrument created to help university students reflect on study-induced fatigue and identify when academic strain requires rest or campus support.
instructions: For each item below, please select the response that best describes your experience over the past two weeks. Be as honest as possible. Your answers are private to your session.
source: Calma Educational Prototype - Adapted from academic burnout literature (conceptual MBI-SS dimensions).
validation_status: Project-created screening questions; non-diagnostic; statistical inputs to Model B regression.
disclaimer: This screening tool is for educational self-awareness only. It does not provide a psychiatric or clinical medical diagnosis. If you feel overwhelmed, free campus counseling services are available.

scoring.type: Continuous 0-10 Risk Estimation via HistGradientBoostingRegressor (Model B)
scoring.interpretation: Scores between 0.0-3.9 suggest manageable workload and adequate rest. Scores between 4.0-6.9 suggest moderate strain where proactive study pauses are recommended. Scores between 7.0-10.0 indicate high fatigue where lightening study sprints and speaking with an advisor or counselor is strongly advised.

questions.text: How often do you feel emotionally and mentally exhausted by your academic coursework?
At the end of a typical study day, how drained of energy do you feel?
To what degree do you feel disconnected, indifferent, or cynical about the purpose of your degree assignments?
How confident do you feel in your capability to master challenging concepts in your upcoming courses?
How would you rate the current overall pressure from impending exams and project deadlines?
How difficult is it for you to balance academic study demands with adequate personal rest and social life?

scale_labels.5: Constant conflict between study and rest

questions.text: When you have a demanding academic week, how easily are you able to mentally recover over the weekend?

scale_labels.1: Unable to recover; exhaustion carries over
scale_labels.2: Takes multiple days to regain energy

questions.text: How supported do you feel by peers, study groups, friends, or family during stressful academic periods?
